headline: Indian IT services showed solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by strong AI‑driven sales.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS posted ₹73,188 cr revenue with a 24% operating margin. HCLTech and Tech Mahindra highlighted AI as a key driver. Several firms (Infosys, Coforge, Mphasis, Wipro) have not yet released full results, adding uncertainty.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue surged across multiple companies, contributing to higher margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Margin pressure at mid‑tier firms
themes.detail: Companies like Persistent and OFSS showed lower operating margins despite revenue gains.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 21.2% YoY and profit rose 15.6% YoY, indicating strong execution.
Largest revenue base with 15.4% YoY growth and a healthy 24% operating margin.

laggards.why: Profit fell 27% YoY after a costly acquisition, despite revenue growth.
Results not released, creating a data gap and uncertainty.
